# Ruqya Healing — Application Overview

## Purpose
Multilingual (en/bs) Next.js web application delivering Islamic spiritual healing content: Ruqya (Quran-based healing), prophetic medicine, audio lectures, and wellness consulting. Brand: "Ruqya Healing".

## Tech Stack
- Next.js 15 (App Router, Turbopack dev)
- TypeScript 5.9
- PostgreSQL via Prisma 7.8
- Supabase Storage (audio bucket: rukja-audio; image bucket: images)
- NextAuth v5 beta for admin authentication
- Tailwind CSS 4 with custom palette (olive/gold/cream)

## Routing Structure
All public routes are locale-prefixed: /en/... and /bs/...
Middleware auto-redirects unlocalized paths to detected locale (cookie > Accept-Language > geo > default "en").

### Public Pages
| Route | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| /[lang] | SSG | Landing page — hero, what-is-Ruqya, services grid, daily adhkar, contact form |
| /[lang]/lectures | SSG | Lecture listing with category filter (aqidah/family/general) |
| /[lang]/lectures/[slug] | SSG | Individual lecture detail page |
| /[lang]/audio | SSG | Audio listing — lectures and educational content |
| /[lang]/audio/[slug] | SSG | Individual audio detail with custom player |

### Admin Routes (auth-gated)
| Route | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| /admin | Server | Admin dashboard |
| /admin/lectures | Server | Lecture CRUD management |
| /admin/audio | Server | Audio upload/management |

### API Routes
| Method | Endpoint | Auth | Description |
|--------|----------|------|-------------|
| GET | /api/lectures?lang=en&category=... | None | List all lectures, optional category filter |
| GET | /api/lectures/[slug]?lang=en | None | Single lecture detail |
| GET | /api/audio?lang=en&type=lecture|ruqya | None | List all audio items, optional type filter |
| POST | /api/admin/lectures | NextAuth | Create lecture (JSON body) |
| PUT | /api/admin/lecture/[id] | NextAuth | Update lecture (multipart form-data) |
| DELETE | /api/admin/lecture/[id] | NextAuth | Delete lecture + associated image |
| POST | /api/admin/lectures/upload | NextAuth | Create lecture with image upload (multipart) |
| POST | /api/admin/audios | NextAuth | List audios (GET-only endpoint) |
| POST | /api/admin/audio/upload | NextAuth | Upload audio file or YouTube link to Supabase |
| PATCH | /api/admin/audio/[id] | NextAuth | Update audio (multipart form-data) |
| DELETE | /api/admin/audio/[id] | NextAuth | Delete audio + associated file |
| GET | /api/download?type=file|youtube&src=...&title=... | None | Stream/transcode audio to MP3 via ffmpeg |
| GET/POST | /api/auth/[...nextauth] | NextAuth | Authentication handler |

### Static Assets
| Route | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| /sitemap.xml | Dynamic sitemap (static pages + dynamic lecture/audio entries) |
| /robots.txt | Disallow /admin and /api; reference sitemap |
| /images/* | Static images (hero, placeholders, etc.) |

## Content Model
The app manages two primary content types:

1. **Lectures** — Written articles with bilingual titles, excerpts, full content, author, and category. Each has an associated cover image.
2. **Audio** — Recorded content (lectures or Ruqya sessions) stored as either uploaded files in Supabase or YouTube embed URLs.

Both support English (en) and Bosnian (bs) translations.

## Design System
- Background: cream #F6F1E9
- Foreground text: deep olive #2D3627
- Primary accent: muted gold #C19853
- Typography: Marcellus (headings), Manrope (body), Amiri (Arabic text)
- Tailwind config defines: olive (50-950), gold (50-900), cream (50-500) scales

## External Crawling
- robots.txt allows all user agents to crawl public paths, disallows /admin and /api
- sitemap.xml includes all locale-prefixed pages and dynamic content URLs
- OpenGraph metadata set per locale (en_US / bs_BA)
- JSON-LD structured data (Organization + WebSite schemas) injected in layout
